pages.text: A duplicate relic is the worst kind of loot: a visible reward worth nothing. In the Relic Economy, surplus relics and curios distil into $(bold)Relic Essence$(), which you spend at the $(bold)Relic Broker$().$(br2)$(note)Relic Essence buys goods from the Broker; it is not a progression token and never advances a tier (see $(l:icraft:loot/token_system)Progression Tokens$(/l)).

pages.title: Banking Surplus
pages.text: Carry your spare relics and curios and run $(bold)/icraft relics submit$() to preview the haul, then $(bold)submit confirm$() to bank it as essence. The $(bold)Submit$() button in the $(bold)Bank Relic Surplus$() quest (Iridescent Codex group) banks in one click.

pages.title: Banking Surplus, cont.
pages.text: Eligible: the seven artifact/curio mods plus boss-signature relics, and $(bold)boss relics are worth far more$() than common artifacts. Only your backpack counts; worn relics are never touched.$(br2)Check your balance with $(bold)/icraft relics balance$().

pages.title: The Relic Broker
pages.text: Right-click a $(bold)Relic Broker Stand$() to trade essence. Its catalog grows with your tier ($(t2)II$(), $(t3)III$(), $(t4)IV$()):$(li)$(bold)Enchant books$(): utility early, chase enchants later.$(li)$(bold)Materials$(): gem dust, arcane essence, Tetra and boss mats.$(li)$(bold)Spell scrolls$(): a random bound spell.$(li)$(bold)Convenience$(): paid in emeralds, not essence.$(br2)The Broker also $(bold)buys back$() your boss relics for essence.

pages.title: Stock & Limits
pages.text: The Broker's rotating materials and scrolls $(bold)reroll each day$(), so check back. Purchases are capped at about $(bold)ten per day$(); selling back is unlimited.$(br2)A Broker stands at the spawn safe-haven. From $(t2)Tier 2$() you can craft your own $(bold)Relic Broker Stand$() from a stack of essence to bank, distil and trade without the trip home.$(br2)$(bold)Next: run /icraft relics submit.$()
